description: 10-K risk factors — Pull the Item 1A Risk Factors section from a company's latest (or earlier, filing=0-4) Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR and structure it: risk categories with counts, every risk heading in order (limit= default 80, max 200), section word count, theme mentions (cybersecurity, AI, tariffs, China, interest rates, supply chain, regulation, litigation...) and red flags (going concern, material weakness, delisting, restatement). ticker= or cik=. Headings are detected from the filing's formatting, so counts are approximate. Public-domain SEC data. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
